data.one_liner: Navigate between routes, show dialogs, and access context globally without passing BuildContext.
data.what_it_does: Provides global navigation methods, animated transitions, dialog/bottom sheet helpers, and global access to context-dependent objects like MediaQuery, Theme, and ScaffoldMessenger without requiring a BuildContext instance.
use_when: You want a lightweight imperative navigation setup without writing complex routing declarations
You need to navigate or show dialogs/snackbars from non-widget classes where BuildContext is unavailable
avoid_when: You prefer declarative routing with deep linking support
You rely on type-safe argument passing and route generation structures
strengths: Enables navigation and messenger calls from anywhere without BuildContext
Includes built-in support for animated page transitions and custom route types
weaknesses: Relies on a global navigator key, which can cause issues in multi-navigator or complex modular architectures
Does not support declarative routing or native deep linking features out of the box
data.setup_notes: Pass Go.navigatorKey to the navigatorKey property of MaterialApp in main.dart.

alternatives.name: go_router
alternatives.why_pick_it: Choose go_router for robust declarative routing, URL path synchronization, and deep linking support.

alternatives.name: auto_route
alternatives.why_pick_it: Choose auto_route for heavily type-safe routing and deep linking with code generation.
